title: Antonio Trillanes appears at Senate
summary: Former Sen. Antonio Trillanes IV on Tuesday appeared at the Senate where Davao City Mayor Sebastian "Baste" Duterte is testifying for his sister Vice President Sara Duterte's impeachment trial.
